result.finding: All neutral fields remain visually close. S and ConvNeXt10k shift the warm flat conspicuously darker/desaturated relative to GT and their earlier stage; B10k has a smaller high-noise warm shift but a larger ADC warm error. V43 high-noise fields remain close. Four selected hues/one draw are not a representative photographic ranking or a training-cause proof.
